skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the operation of mobile application software, classify and practice various types of mobile applications and development methods.
Apply basic programming techniques proficiently for mobile application development.
Apply advanced testing techniques to assess the quality and performance of complete mobile applications.
Execute code snippets and solve exercises assigned by instructors.
Proficiently search, collect, synthesize, analyze, and present solutions to mobile application programming problems.
Collaborate effectively with team members to solve group assignments and ensure timely completion of tasks.
Answer questions posed by instructors, complete in-class and homework assignments.
Participate in group discussions to solve problems and defend personal opinions before the group.
Complete instructor-assigned projects, collaborate with team members to finish tasks.
